topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The moment my sister and I stepped into grandma’s house, it was like we breathed in too much of the past, the air thick with silence and the faint scent of her lavender sachets. Every creak of the floorboards felt like a whisper, like grandma herself was unsure if we should really be there. The will hadn’t been a surprise, but the weight of it all pressed down, the walls feeling closer than they should. We sorted through boxes, each item a story we didn’t know if we wanted to keep. Outside, the sky was a heavy grey, matching the unease in my chest as we wondered what to do with this house, this life, and the fragments of it scattered around us.
